_comment: DWD's 23 lake warning areas (dwd:Warngebiete_Binnenseen, listed 30.10.2026 by scripts/lake_lights_check.py) and whether the lake has flashing storm lights on the shore. The app explains the lights only where lights is true. An area missing here counts as no lights. Re-check when DWD adds an area.

areas.name: Alster
areas.source: No storm lights found for the Alster; DWD warns for the area, the app shows the warning.
